variables.description: Configured OIE scrape targets, including empty and unreachable hypervisors. Instance presence does not determine host visibility.
variables.label: Hypervisor
variables.name: gvar_oie_hypervisor

variables.description: Project name and full UUID. Filtering and links use the UUID, so duplicate names remain distinct.
variables.label: Project
variables.name: gvar_oie_project_uuid

variables.description: Additional name constraint on the selected Project UUIDs. Duplicate names can match more than one UUID. Keep All unless a name filter is needed; Reset scope clears carried filters.
variables.label: Project name filter
variables.name: gvar_oie_project_name

variables.description: Select All, several instances, or one instance. Names are displayed with full UUIDs; queries and links use UUID identity.
variables.label: Instance
variables.name: gvar_oie_instance_uuid

variables.description: Limits matching storage panels to source/backing volume identities. All also includes local disks. CPU, memory and network keep the selected instance scope. Retype tables match the source RBD image, not the destination.
variables.label: Volume UUID (disk panels)
variables.name: gvar_oie_volume_uuid

variables.description: Maximum matching series per graph query, not a guaranteed number of lines or visible legend rows. Multiple queries can each return N series. 0 (All) uses the existing large graph limit. Tables are not limited.
variables.label: Top N / query
variables.name: gvar_oie_top_n

variables.description: Max in range (default) selects the highest plotted values in the selected time window. Mean in range uses their average. Last observed uses the last available sample, which may predate the range end; earlier peaks can be excluded. Saved URL selections remain active. Legend column sorting changes display order only. Full graph, legend and table guidance is in the Scope, time and dashboard help panel.
variables.label: Select top series by
variables.name: gvar_oie_rank_by
variables.query: Last observed : last_over_time,Max in range : max_over_time,Mean in range : avg_over_time

variables.description: Configured OIE scrape targets, including empty and unreachable hypervisors. Instance presence does not determine host visibility.
variables.label: Hypervisor

variables.description: Project name and full UUID. Filtering and links use the UUID, so duplicate names remain distinct.
variables.label: Project
variables.name: gvar_oie_project_uuid

variables.description: Additional name filter applied to the selected project UUIDs. Leave All to include every selected project, including duplicate names.
variables.label: Project name filter
variables.name: gvar_oie_project_name

variables.description: Names are for display; every selection and link filters by the instance UUID.
variables.label: Instance (name | UUID)
variables.name: gvar_oie_instance_uuid

variables.description: Maximum ranked projects in graphs. Comparison panels use a shared project set; panel help names the ranking measurement. Source, direction and list companions can produce more than N lines. 0 (All) uses the large graph limit. Tables remain unlimited.
variables.label: Top projects / query
variables.name: gvar_oie_top_projects

variables.description: Rank projects by the highest plotted value (Max), average plotted value (Mean), or latest available sample (Last observed). Last observed can include ended series. Comparison panels use the ranking measurement named in their help. Legend sorting changes display order only.
variables.label: Select projects by
variables.name: gvar_oie_rank_projects_by
variables.query: Last observed : last_over_time,Max in range : max_over_time,Mean in range : avg_over_time

variables.description: Maximum matching series per graph query, not a guaranteed number of lines or visible legend rows. Multiple queries can each return N series. 0 (All) uses the existing large graph limit. Tables are not limited.
variables.label: Top instances / query
variables.name: gvar_oie_top_instances

variables.description: Rank instances by the highest plotted value (Max), average plotted value (Mean), or latest available sample (Last observed). Last observed can predate the range end. Saved URL selections remain active; legend sorting changes display order only.
variables.label: Select instances by
variables.name: gvar_oie_rank_instances_by
variables.query: Last observed : last_over_time,Max in range : max_over_time,Mean in range : avg_over_time

title: OpenStack Instance Exporter — Threat List Overview

variables.description: Configured OIE scrape targets, including empty and unreachable hypervisors. Instance presence does not determine host visibility.
variables.label: Hypervisor
variables.name: gvar_oie_hypervisor

variables.description: Project name and full UUID. Filtering and links use the UUID, so duplicate names remain distinct.
variables.label: Project
variables.name: gvar_oie_project_uuid

variables.description: Additional name filter within the selected project UUIDs. Project and name filters both apply; a saved name selection can hide otherwise matching instances. Reset scope clears both filters.
variables.label: Project name filter
variables.name: gvar_oie_project_name

variables.description: Names are for display; every selection and link filters by the instance UUID.
variables.label: Instance (name | UUID)
variables.name: gvar_oie_instance_uuid

variables.description: Limit each graph query to at most N matching series; fewer measurements can produce fewer lines. Multiple queries may each return N series. 0 (All) uses the existing large graph limit. Tables contain all matching rows and are not limited by Top N.
variables.label: Top N per graph query
variables.name: gvar_oie_top_n

variables.description: Choose which series appear in Top N graphs. Max in range (default) uses the highest plotted ranking value; Mean in range uses its average. Last observed uses the latest available sample, which may predate range end and omit earlier peaks. Selection stays fixed over the selected range and samples at the plotted interval, not every raw scrape. Saved URL selections remain active. Legends start with highest Max first; scroll for other rows. Sorting a legend changes display order only. Last is the right-edge value and remains unavailable for ended series; Max is the highest plotted sample.
variables.label: Select top series by
variables.name: gvar_oie_rank_by
variables.query: Last observed : last_over_time,Max in range : max_over_time,Mean in range : avg_over_time
